text:
sam_marketing: Quick heads-up — partner celeb (TBD name) floated including a short shoutout to Redwood in their newsletter next Wed. Could land our blog + a few press pickups. Need alignment on quote, embargo and who signs off. @elaine @jonathan_pr @legal_kate

elaine: Nice! do we have a firm mention copy or just a high-level nod?

sam_marketing: So far just high-level: "Using Redwood Inference to cut latency on chat features". Partner asked if we can provide a one-sentence quote and a suggested blurb for social.

jonathan_pr: If it's a direct quote that reads like an endorsement we need legal sign-off. cc @legal_kate. Also want to know if mention is under embargo or live when newsletter drops.

legal_kate: Happy to review. Can you drop proposed quote here or paste in a doc? We need to confirm no product claims like SLA guarantees.

sam_marketing: Pasting suggested lines: ```"Redwood Inference helped us reduce inference latency by ~40% while keeping output quality high."``` Not final — will adjust to avoid hard numbers. Link to draft assets: https://docs.redwood.in/launch/celeb-partner-draft (internal)

press_ops: +1 on embargo clarity. If newsletter is timed with our blog publish we should coordinate embargo window so press outreach doesn't get ahead. Who can move the blog publish time if needed?

elaine: I can shift the blog to match. Need to know final publish ETA. If partner is locked for Wed 11:00 PT we should set blog to 11:05 PT and social at 11:10 PT to capture the wave.

oliver_social: For socials we'll want the final quote + 2 suggested posts (X/LinkedIn). Can someone draft two variants (short & long) for approval? I can schedule once we have final copy and time.

cecilia_partner: FYI — partner team prefers to run on their schedule. They can push to Tue if their cadence changes. They asked for approved quote 48h before send.

jonathan_pr: Action items: 1) Sam — update quote to remove numeric claim or add source (if we keep number). 2) Legal_kate — review final quote within 24h. 3) Elaine — hold blog slot and be ready to shift publish time. 4) Oliver — prep social variants after quote finalized. 5) Press_ops — hold external outreach until after partner sends.

sam_marketing: I'll update quote now to: "Redwood Inference helped our team reduce inference latency while maintaining output quality." Will post final here in 30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

legal_kate: That wording looks fine at glance. I'll do formal check when final copy is posted.

press_ops: Noted — will freeze press list and patch any embargo dates once we have final timestamp.

oliver_social: Great — once you post final quote I'll mock two post variants and share for quick sign-off.

elaine: If partner moves earlier, ping me immediately. I'll set an alert and keep the CMS draft ready to publish.

sam_marketing: Final quote posted: "Redwood Inference reduced our inference latency while preserving model output quality." Legal, please confirm.

legal_kate: Approved. No further edits from legal. :white_check_mark:

jonathan_pr: Approved. I'll standby on reactive outreach to trade reporters after live.

press_ops: Marking embargo control: HOLD until partner newsletter fires. Will send a one-line update to media list when live.

oliver_social: Drafts up: (1) Short X: "Big news — we partnered with [partner] and cut inference latency with Redwood Inference. Read more: <link>" (2) LinkedIn longer post ready. Sharing for reviews in ~10m. :rocket:

sam_marketing: Thanks team. Closing loop — will confirm final send time from partner and drop it here. If we get name confirm, add a legal release if they want a direct quote from the celeb.

cecilia_partner: Confirmed on their end — newsletter scheduled Wed 11:00 PT. They're ok with the final quote you posted. Good to go from our side.

sam_marketing: Perfect. Blog publish set to 11:05 PT, social at 11:10 PT. I'll post a final "live" message here when published. :tada:
